query:
WITH removed AS (
                DELETE FROM governance_rate_charges
                WHERE call_id = $1 AND bucket_key = $2
                RETURNING expires_at
            )
            UPDATE governance_rate_windows w
            SET hits = GREATEST(w.hits - 1, 0)
            FROM removed r
            WHERE w.bucket_key = $2 AND w.expires_at = r.expires_at
